notes.assist:adaptive-lane-guidance: Group = MQB_A5_AdaptavieLaneAssist (A5 0600, device alt) + MQB_A5_AdaptavieLaneAssistPatch (5F 0B3D/0B1D alt, A5 09A3 bit6 with bit5=1, A5 09A4 bit7 inverted). 09A3/09A4 are only touched by the vendor when the A5 part matches 3Q*980654 (otherwise the block is written back unchanged); on 2Q0 cameras those DIDs may not exist. Audit 2026-11-03: the 09A3/09A4 steps have only the 3Q*980654 variant, so on a 2Q*980653 / *5WA980653* camera (which the vendor A5 0600 part supports) the whole group refuses before writing; supporting them needs an engine notion of a device-scoped optional step.

The method would be a brake-light function (0x18, two sources: Golf 7 PDF + vendor mqb_light_functions) in a free slot of the hazard-button LED lamp record, but the record is not identified on the A0 BCM: the MQB table puts 'Leuchte35 LED Warnblinktaster' at 055F while the PQ26 table in the same vendor file puts the hazard button at 055B (055F = alarm LED), and the live Kushaq 055B/055E/055F are all type 0x24 LEDs with A = 0x3E/0x3F/0x40 (codes >= 0x3B untrusted on the A0 BCM).
